title: Surreal AI Official Music and Dance Video - You Move It For The Soul - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
👉 I post new  AI art and cinematic videos every day — subscribe to follow the journey.

Dance party Monday 😎. Song: "You Move It For The Soul". The dancing in #VEO3 animation is pretty incredible. When you think about where ai animation is now it’s wild. I watched this in 4k on my tv and it looks really great. I made playlists where you can watch on your tv. The quality has gotten so good. Images made using #Midjourney and song made using @sunomusic Please subscribe if you like my videos. It really helps and thank you so much for watching. I really appreciate it so much.
